method: Every actual neutral technology building, nearest of all eight bases, separation from the other neutral buildings, nearest authored main/secondary combat middle region, and both opponents' actual native land paths. The central 33-67% path samples are a comparison, not a new public placement cutoff; map-specific front/side junction judgments are explicit.
